phases.name: Start of Round
phases.summary: In Rounds 2-5, discard the two leftmost face-up Main Orders, slide the remaining four left and reveal two new Main Orders into the rightmost positions; refill Tech displays and ready once-per-round abilities.

phases.name: Work Phase
phases.summary: Players alternate placing one worker and resolving that shared location until every worker has been placed; passing is not allowed. Printed spaces are global; a Shifu may overfill a fully occupied action location. A worker may be placed only if it can perform at least one instance of that location's main action. After every worker and associated effect, resolve end-of-Work abilities, including Glaze Palette, in First Player order.

phases.name: Firing Phase
phases.summary: If ceramics are loaded in either kiln, resolve Test Pieces, secret Contribution-card choices, simultaneous reveal and payment, Base Heat, optional Shifu Heat markers in First Player order, Fire, Actual Heat, Heat adjustments, Quality, player-ordered after-Quality Techs, Ge Crackle, then optional salvage of one still-Flawed ceramic for 2 Coins per player.

phases.name: Order Phase
phases.summary: In reverse turn order, each opportunity completes at most one held or face-up Order or passes. Continue until a full circuit has no completion. Each Crown advances Imperial Recognition by one.

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.summary: Return workers and discard held Orders down to the limit of 3. If the round was not the fifth, pass First Player clockwise and advance the round.
